The live mermaid show.verification: Downloaded the original (1800x1215) from Wikimedia Commons and inspected it directly: the blue front-gate sign reads 'Weeki Wachee Springs' with placards for 'MERMAID SHOWS' and 'RIVER CRUISE', at the park's real US 19 entrance. No properly licensed contemporary photo of the underwater theater performance itself exists on Commons (the only performance photos are pre-1970s Florida State Archives images marked plain public domain, outside this project's allowed licence list, and would show identifiable performers); this on-site sign is the verified stand-in that still shows the exact attraction and place named in the pick.
